articles.title: American Airlines to roll out free Wi-Fi for loyalty program members
articles.mainIdea: American Airlines to roll out free Wi-Fi for loyalty program members
articles.summary: Reuters: American Airlines to roll out free Wi-Fi for loyalty program members. "Free high-speed Wi-Fi isn't just a perk — ‍it's essential for today's travelers," Heather Garboden, chief customer officer of American ​Airlines, said in a statement. In ‌2023, Delta Air Lines became the first major U.S. carrier to offer free in-flight Wi-Fi in partnership with T-Mobile. In 2025, ⁠United Airlines partnered with ​Elon Musk's Starlink ​for in-flight internet services. Related tickers mentioned: AAL, DAL, T.
